title: Skyline
description: Stacked volume per period as blocks, with a smaller outcome in the same unit standing in front. Use when: 7 to 40 periods of stacked volume and a smaller outcome in the same unit (failures, retries), as the lead card of a dashboard. Avoid when: Negative values, precise value comparison (bars are more accurate), or two values in different units (split the chart and link it with syncId)

y.description: Back row fields stacked into each block. An array for wide tables (number)

series.description: Series field (long tables, back row only) (string)

front.description: Front row fields: a smaller outcome in the same unit as y (wide tables only) (number)

depth.description: Back row depth as a share of the period slot, from 0.1 to 0.32. Values outside are pulled into the range

wall.description: Value grid on the back wall, with its labels on the right

texture.description: Rows that get the hatch pattern, for print and for readers who cannot tell the grays apart

frontRate.description: Front row total as a share of the back row: "label" in a label and the tooltip, "strip" as a rate strip under the floor, false hides it

dayFirst.description: Reads dates such as "05/03/2024", where either part could be the month, day first (5 March). Without it, a clear date in the column decides (25/03/2024), otherwise month first. true also reads "05.03.24" as day.month.year

height.description: Height in px. Without it, each chart picks a default that fits its width

width.description: Fixed width in px. Without it, the chart fits its parent

highlight.description: Item to highlight. An index, a name, an array, or "max" | "min" | "first" | "last" | "none"

format.description: Value format. "number" | "integer" | "percent" (values are already percents: 42 → "42%") | "ratio" (0.42 → "42%") | "compact" | "currency" (KRW for Korean locales, otherwise USD; for another currency pass Intl options with currency) | "decimal" or Intl.NumberFormat options

anyOf.description: Intl.NumberFormat options plus suffix and prefix

unit.description: Unit appended to values. For example "%" or "ms"

locale.description: Locale for numbers, dates and the text a chart writes itself (tooltips, screen reader sentences). "ko" or "ko-*" switches to Korean. Falls back to the ThemeProvider locale

stagger.description: Delay between items as they enter (ms)

reducedMotion.description: "auto" follows the OS setting. true always turns motion off

animateOnView.description: Play when the chart scrolls into view

showLabels.description: Labels drawn on the chart (values and names)

syncId.description: Charts with the same syncId show the hovered x together (line, area, bar, candlestick). <ChartGrid sync> sets one for every chart inside it

description.description: Description for screen readers. Built from the data when omitted

tooltip.description: Show tooltips. { template: "{label} · {value} · owner {owner}" } writes them: {label}, {value}, {series} or any other column of the row. \n starts a new line, and a line with an empty value is left out

data.description: An array of objects, or one of { values }, { csv }, { url }

csv.description: CSV text (the first line is the header)

url.description: JSON or CSV address (REST API, Google Sheets CSV export and so on)

select.description: Path to the array inside the response JSON. For example "data.items"

card.description: Wraps the chart in a card with a number, title, legend, one-line takeaway, level badge, source line and download buttons

takeaway.description: Bold one-line takeaway at the bottom

legend.description: "auto" builds the legend from the data. "toggle" also lets viewers click it to show and hide series in the browser (line, area, bar, scatter). Images and static HTML draw it like "auto"

sample.description: Marks the data as sample data

source.description: Source line under the chart, after "Source: "

note.description: Note on the same line, such as the as-of date

accent.description: A word of the title to color with the accent color, used instead of a legend

download.description: Download buttons in the browser: true for CSV, SVG and PNG, or a list. Not drawn in SVG, PNG or static HTML
